name: Henry County, GA
findings: Henry County has 1,084 nonprofit organizations. 323 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 233 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Henry County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list membership
observations.text: 7 hobby and sports organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 20 would.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 27 would.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Henry County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 112 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 112 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
